attrs.Help_string: What this block does: Chasis Block. How to use it: fill the key fields below before build. SetParent: set the target node name. If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup. Tip: start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need. Template parent examples: Chasis_Center_Suspension_Ctrl, Chasis_Center_Ctrl, Spine_End_Jnt.
